[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = [
    "crates/lumen-model",
    "crates/lumen-session",
    "crates/lumen-analysis",
    "crates/lumen-pattern",
    "crates/lumen-store",
    "crates/lumen-fixtures",
    "crates/lumen-cli",
]

[workspace.package]
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.96"
authors = ["Gabriel Castro (Orin DX)"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/orin-dx/lumen"

[workspace.dependencies]
# Internal workspace crates
lumen-model = { path = "crates/lumen-model" }
lumen-session = { path = "crates/lumen-session" }
lumen-analysis = { path = "crates/lumen-analysis" }
lumen-pattern = { path = "crates/lumen-pattern" }
lumen-store = { path = "crates/lumen-store" }
lumen-fixtures = { path = "crates/lumen-fixtures" }

# Database & Storage
rusqlite = { version = "0.32", features = ["bundled", "chrono"] }
r2d2 = "0.8"
r2d2_sqlite = "0.25"
camino = { version = "1.1", features = ["serde1"] }
tempfile = "3.13"
proptest = "1.6"
insta = { version = "1.41", features = ["json", "yaml", "redactions"] }
rstest = "0.23"
pretty_assertions = "1.4"
criterion = "0.5"




# Data structures & serialization
compact_str = { version = "0.8", features = ["serde"] }
smallvec = { version = "1.13", features = ["serde"] }
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0"
chrono = { version = "0.4", features = ["serde"] }
simd-json = "0.14"

# Graph and parallel processing
petgraph = "0.6"
rayon = "1.10"
memmap2 = "0.9"

# Error handling & CLI
thiserror = "2.0"
miette = { version = "7.4", features = ["fancy"] }
clap = { version = "4.5", features = ["derive", "env"] }
comfy-table = "7.1"
anstream = "0.6"
anstyle = "1.0"
indicatif = "0.17"
tracing = "0.1"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", features = ["env-filter"] }

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1

[workspace.lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"
unused_must_use = "deny"
let_underscore_drop = "deny"

[workspace.lints.clippy]
all = { level = "warn", priority = -1 }
unwrap_used = "allow"

use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
use comfy_table::modifiers::UTF8_ROUND_CORNERS;
use comfy_table::presets::UTF8_FULL;
use comfy_table::{Cell, Color, Row, Table};
use lumen_model::*;
use lumen_session::*;
use miette::{IntoDiagnostic, Result};
use std::fs::File;
use std::io::BufReader;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
#[command(name = "lumen", author, version, about = "Multi-orchestrator telemetry & session intelligence engine")]
pub struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    pub command: Commands,

    #[arg(long, global = true, help = "Emit machine-readable JSON format")]
    pub json: bool,
}

#[derive(Subcommand, Debug)]
pub enum Commands {
    /// Render execution trajectory DAG and timeline
    Trace {
        /// Path to JSONL session log
        session_path: PathBuf,
    },
    /// Audit token economics, prompt cache hit %, and USD cost
    Audit {
        /// Path to JSONL session log
        session_path: PathBuf,
    },
    /// Parallel scan across all sessions in a directory
    Scan {
        /// Directory to scan
        #[arg(default_value = ".")]
        dir: PathBuf,
    },
}

fn main() -> Result<()> {
    let cli = Cli::parse();

    match cli.command {
        Commands::Trace { session_path } => cmd_trace(&session_path, cli.json)?,
        Commands::Audit { session_path } => cmd_audit(&session_path, cli.json)?,
        Commands::Scan { dir } => cmd_scan(&dir, cli.json)?,
    }

    Ok(())
}

fn load_session(path: &Path) -> Result<CanonicalTranscript> {
    let file = File::open(path).into_diagnostic()?;
    let reader = BufReader::new(file);

    // Read initial sample for fingerprinting
    let mut sample_file = File::open(path).into_diagnostic()?;
    let mut buffer = [0u8; 2048];
    use std::io::Read;
    let n = sample_file.read(&mut buffer).unwrap_or(0);
    let sample = &buffer[..n];

    let orchestrator = detect_orchestrator(sample).unwrap_or(OrchestratorKind::ClaudeCode);

    match orchestrator {
        OrchestratorKind::ClaudeCode => ClaudeCodeAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
        OrchestratorKind::Antigravity => AgyAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
        OrchestratorKind::Codex => CodexAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
        OrchestratorKind::OpenCode => OpenCodeAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
        _ => ClaudeCodeAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
    }
}

fn cmd_trace(path: &Path, json_mode: bool) -> Result<()> {
    let transcript = load_session(path)?;

    if json_mode {
        let json_out = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&transcript).into_diagnostic()?;
        println!("{}", json_out);
        return Ok(());
    }

    println!("\n Session Trajectory: {}", transcript.session_id);
    println!(" Orchestrator: {:?} | Model: {}", transcript.orchestrator, transcript.model_family);
    println!(" Turns: {} | Wall Time: {}ms\n", transcript.turns.len(), transcript.timing.wall_duration_ms);

    let mut table = Table::new();
    table.load_preset(UTF8_FULL).apply_modifier(UTF8_ROUND_CORNERS).set_header(Row::from(vec![
        "Turn",
        "Role",
        "Tool Invocations",
        "Tokens (In / Write / Read / Out)",
    ]));

    for turn in &transcript.turns {
        let tool_summary = if turn.tool_calls.is_empty() {
            "-".to_string()
        } else {
            turn.tool_calls.iter().map(|c| format!("{}({})", c.tool_name, c.call_id)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ")
        };

        let token_summary = if let Some(u) = turn.usage {
            format!("{}/{}/{}/{}", u.input_tokens, u.cache_creation_tokens, u.cache_read_tokens, u.output_tokens)
        } else {
            "-".to_string()
        };

        table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
            Cell::new(turn.turn_index.to_string()),
            Cell::new(format!("{:?}", turn.role)),
            Cell::new(tool_summary),
            Cell::new(token_summary),
        ]));
    }

    println!("{table}");
    Ok(())
}

fn cmd_audit(path: &Path, json_mode: bool) -> Result<()> {
    let transcript = load_session(path)?;
    let eco = &transcript.economics;

    if json_mode {
        let json_out = serde_json::to_string_pretty(eco).into_diagnostic()?;
        println!("{}", json_out);
        return Ok(());
    }

    println!("\n Token Economics & Cache Audit: {}", transcript.session_id);
    println!(" Model: {}\n", transcript.model_family);

    let mut table = Table::new();
    table.load_preset(UTF8_FULL).apply_modifier(UTF8_ROUND_CORNERS).set_header(Row::from(vec!["Metric", "Value"]));

    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Uncached Input Tokens", &format!("{}", eco.input_tokens)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Cache Creation (5m Write)", &format!("{}", eco.cache_creation_tokens)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Cache Read (0.10x Discount)", &format!("{}", eco.cache_read_tokens)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Output Tokens", &format!("{}", eco.output_tokens)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
        Cell::new("Cache Hit Ratio").fg(Color::Green),
        Cell::new(format!("{:.1}%", eco.cache_hit_ratio)).fg(Color::Green),
    ]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
        Cell::new("Actual USD Spend").fg(Color::Cyan),
        Cell::new(format!("${:.4}", eco.total_cost_usd)).fg(Color::Cyan),
    ]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Baseline Cost (No Cache)", &format!("${:.4}", eco.baseline_cost_no_cache_usd)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
        Cell::new("Net Savings USD").fg(Color::Green),
        Cell::new(format!("${:.4}", eco.net_savings_usd)).fg(Color::Green),
    ]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
        Cell::new("Efficiency Multiplier").fg(Color::Yellow),
        Cell::new(format!("{:.2}x", eco.efficiency_multiplier)).fg(Color::Yellow),
    ]));

    println!("{table}");
    Ok(())
}

fn cmd_scan(dir: &Path, json_mode: bool) -> Result<()> {
    use std::fs;

    let mut sessions = Vec::new();

    if dir.is_dir() {
        for entry in fs::read_dir(dir).into_diagnostic()? {
            let entry = entry.into_diagnostic()?;
            let path = entry.path();
            if path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some("jsonl") {
                if let Ok(transcript) = load_session(&path) {
                    sessions.push(transcript);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if json_mode {
        let json_out = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&sessions).into_diagnostic()?;
        println!("{}", json_out);
        return Ok(());
    }

    println!("\n Multi-Session Directory Scan: {}", dir.display());
    println!(" Total Sessions Discovered: {}\n", sessions.len());

    let mut table = Table::new();
    table.load_preset(UTF8_FULL).apply_modifier(UTF8_ROUND_CORNERS).set_header(Row::from(vec![
        "Session ID",
        "Orchestrator",
        "Turns",
        "Cache Hit %",
        "Cost USD",
        "Savings USD",
    ]));

    for sess in &sessions {
        table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
            Cell::new(sess.session_id.as_str()),
            Cell::new(format!("{:?}", sess.orchestrator)),
            Cell::new(sess.turns.len().to_string()),
            Cell::new(format!("{:.1}%", sess.economics.cache_hit_ratio)),
            Cell::new(format!("${:.4}", sess.economics.total_cost_usd)),
            Cell::new(format!("${:.4}", sess.economics.net_savings_usd)),
        ]));
    }

    println!("{table}");
    Ok(())
}

use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
use comfy_table::modifiers::UTF8_ROUND_CORNERS;
use comfy_table::presets::UTF8_FULL;
use comfy_table::{Cell, Color, Row, Table};
use lumen_model::*;
use lumen_session::*;
use miette::{IntoDiagnostic, Result};
use std::fs::File;
use std::io::BufReader;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
#[command(name = "lumen", author, version, about = "Multi-orchestrator telemetry & session intelligence engine")]
pub struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    pub command: Commands,

    #[arg(long, global = true, help = "Emit machine-readable JSON format")]
    pub json: bool,
}

#[derive(Subcommand, Debug)]
pub enum Commands {
    /// Render execution trajectory DAG and timeline
    Trace {
        /// Path to JSONL session log
        session_path: PathBuf,
    },
    /// Audit token economics, prompt cache hit %, and USD cost
    Audit {
        /// Path to JSONL session log
        session_path: PathBuf,
    },
    /// Parallel scan across all sessions in a directory
    Scan {
        /// Directory to scan
        #[arg(default_value = ".")]
        dir: PathBuf,
    },
}

fn main() -> Result<()> {
    let cli = Cli::parse();

    match cli.command {
        Commands::Trace { session_path } => cmd_trace(&session_path, cli.json)?,
        Commands::Audit { session_path } => cmd_audit(&session_path, cli.json)?,
        Commands::Scan { dir } => cmd_scan(&dir, cli.json)?,
    }

    Ok(())
}

fn load_session(path: &Path) -> Result<CanonicalTranscript> {
    let file = File::open(path).into_diagnostic()?;
    let reader = BufReader::new(file);

    // Read initial sample for fingerprinting
    let mut sample_file = File::open(path).into_diagnostic()?;
    let mut buffer = [0u8; 2048];
    use std::io::Read;
    let n = sample_file.read(&mut buffer).unwrap_or(0);
    let sample = &buffer[..n];

    let orchestrator = detect_orchestrator(sample).unwrap_or(OrchestratorKind::ClaudeCode);

    match orchestrator {
        OrchestratorKind::ClaudeCode => ClaudeCodeAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
        OrchestratorKind::Antigravity => AgyAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
        OrchestratorKind::Codex => CodexAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
        OrchestratorKind::OpenCode => OpenCodeAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
        _ => ClaudeCodeAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
    }
}

fn cmd_trace(path: &Path, json_mode: bool) -> Result<()> {
    let transcript = load_session(path)?;

    if json_mode {
        let json_out = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&transcript).into_diagnostic()?;
        println!("{}", json_out);
        return Ok(());
    }

    println!("\n Session Trajectory: {}", transcript.session_id);
    println!(" Orchestrator: {:?} | Model: {}", transcript.orchestrator, transcript.model_family);
    println!(" Turns: {} | Wall Time: {}ms\n", transcript.turns.len(), transcript.timing.wall_duration_ms);

    let mut table = Table::new();
    table.load_preset(UTF8_FULL).apply_modifier(UTF8_ROUND_CORNERS).set_header(Row::from(vec![
        "Turn",
        "Role",
        "Tool Invocations",
        "Tokens (In / Write / Read / Out)",
    ]));

    for turn in &transcript.turns {
        let tool_summary = if turn.tool_calls.is_empty() {
            "-".to_string()
        } else {
            turn.tool_calls.iter().map(|c| format!("{}({})", c.tool_name, c.call_id)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ")
        };

        let token_summary = if let Some(u) = turn.usage {
            format!("{}/{}/{}/{}", u.input_tokens, u.cache_creation_tokens, u.cache_read_tokens, u.output_tokens)
        } else {
            "-".to_string()
        };

        table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
            Cell::new(turn.turn_index.to_string()),
            Cell::new(format!("{:?}", turn.role)),
            Cell::new(tool_summary),
            Cell::new(token_summary),
        ]));
    }

    println!("{table}");
    Ok(())
}

fn cmd_audit(path: &Path, json_mode: bool) -> Result<()> {
    let transcript = load_session(path)?;
    let eco = &transcript.economics;

    if json_mode {
        let json_out = serde_json::to_string_pretty(eco).into_diagnostic()?;
        println!("{}", json_out);
        return Ok(());
    }

    println!("\n Token Economics & Cache Audit: {}", transcript.session_id);
    println!(" Model: {}\n", transcript.model_family);

    let mut table = Table::new();
    table.load_preset(UTF8_FULL).apply_modifier(UTF8_ROUND_CORNERS).set_header(Row::from(vec!["Metric", "Value"]));

    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Uncached Input Tokens", &format!("{}", eco.input_tokens)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Cache Creation (5m Write)", &format!("{}", eco.cache_creation_tokens)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Cache Read (0.10x Discount)", &format!("{}", eco.cache_read_tokens)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Output Tokens", &format!("{}", eco.output_tokens)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
        Cell::new("Cache Hit Ratio").fg(Color::Green),
        Cell::new(format!("{:.1}%", eco.cache_hit_ratio)).fg(Color::Green),
    ]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
        Cell::new("Actual USD Spend").fg(Color::Cyan),
        Cell::new(format!("${:.4}", eco.total_cost_usd)).fg(Color::Cyan),
    ]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Baseline Cost (No Cache)", &format!("${:.4}", eco.baseline_cost_no_cache_usd)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
        Cell::new("Net Savings USD").fg(Color::Green),
        Cell::new(format!("${:.4}", eco.net_savings_usd)).fg(Color::Green),
    ]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
        Cell::new("Efficiency Multiplier").fg(Color::Yellow),
        Cell::new(format!("{:.2}x", eco.efficiency_multiplier)).fg(Color::Yellow),
    ]));

    println!("{table}");
    Ok(())
}

fn cmd_scan(dir: &Path, json_mode: bool) -> Result<()> {
    use std::fs;

    let mut sessions = Vec::new();

    if dir.is_dir() {
        for entry in fs::read_dir(dir).into_diagnostic()? {
            let entry = entry.into_diagnostic()?;
            let path = entry.path();
            if path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some("jsonl") {
                if let Ok(transcript) = load_session(&path) {
                    sessions.push(transcript);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if json_mode {
        let json_out = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&sessions).into_diagnostic()?;
        println!("{}", json_out);
        return Ok(());
    }

    println!("\n Multi-Session Directory Scan: {}", dir.display());
    println!(" Total Sessions Discovered: {}\n", sessions.len());

    let mut table = Table::new();
    table.load_preset(UTF8_FULL).apply_modifier(UTF8_ROUND_CORNERS).set_header(Row::from(vec![
        "Session ID",
        "Orchestrator",
        "Turns",
        "Cache Hit %",
        "Cost USD",
        "Savings USD",
    ]));

    for sess in &sessions {
        table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
            Cell::new(sess.session_id.as_str()),
            Cell::new(format!("{:?}", sess.orchestrator)),
            Cell::new(sess.turns.len().to_string()),
            Cell::new(format!("{:.1}%", sess.economics.cache_hit_ratio)),
            Cell::new(format!("${:.4}", sess.economics.total_cost_usd)),
            Cell::new(format!("${:.4}", sess.economics.net_savings_usd)),
        ]));
    }

    println!("{table}");
    Ok(())
}

use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
use comfy_table::modifiers::UTF8_ROUND_CORNERS;
use comfy_table::presets::UTF8_FULL;
use comfy_table::{Cell, Color, Row, Table};
use lumen_model::*;
use lumen_session::*;
use miette::{IntoDiagnostic, Result};
use std::fs::File;
use std::io::BufReader;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
#[command(name = "lumen", author, version, about = "Multi-orchestrator telemetry & session intelligence engine")]
pub struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    pub command: Commands,

    #[arg(long, global = true, help = "Emit machine-readable JSON format")]
    pub json: bool,
}

#[derive(Subcommand, Debug)]
pub enum Commands {
    /// Render execution trajectory DAG and timeline
    Trace {
        /// Path to JSONL session log
        session_path: PathBuf,
    },
    /// Audit token economics, prompt cache hit %, and USD cost
    Audit {
        /// Path to JSONL session log
        session_path: PathBuf,
    },
    /// Parallel scan across all sessions in a directory
    Scan {
        /// Directory to scan
        #[arg(default_value = ".")]
        dir: PathBuf,
    },
}

fn main() -> Result<()> {
    let cli = Cli::parse();

    match cli.command {
        Commands::Trace { session_path } => cmd_trace(&session_path, cli.json)?,
        Commands::Audit { session_path } => cmd_audit(&session_path, cli.json)?,
        Commands::Scan { dir } => cmd_scan(&dir, cli.json)?,
    }

    Ok(())
}

fn load_session(path: &Path) -> Result<CanonicalTranscript> {
    let file = File::open(path).into_diagnostic()?;
    let reader = BufReader::new(file);

    // Read initial sample for fingerprinting
    let mut sample_file = File::open(path).into_diagnostic()?;
    let mut buffer = [0u8; 2048];
    use std::io::Read;
    let n = sample_file.read(&mut buffer).unwrap_or(0);
    let sample = &buffer[..n];

    let orchestrator = detect_orchestrator(sample).unwrap_or(OrchestratorKind::ClaudeCode);

    match orchestrator {
        OrchestratorKind::ClaudeCode => ClaudeCodeAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
        OrchestratorKind::Antigravity => AgyAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
        OrchestratorKind::Codex => CodexAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
        OrchestratorKind::OpenCode => OpenCodeAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
        _ => ClaudeCodeAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
    }
}

fn cmd_trace(path: &Path, json_mode: bool) -> Result<()> {
    let transcript = load_session(path)?;

    if json_mode {
        let json_out = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&transcript).into_diagnostic()?;
        println!("{}", json_out);
        return Ok(());
    }

    println!("\n Session Trajectory: {}", transcript.session_id);
    println!(" Orchestrator: {:?} | Model: {}", transcript.orchestrator, transcript.model_family);
    println!(" Turns: {} | Wall Time: {}ms\n", transcript.turns.len(), transcript.timing.wall_duration_ms);

    let mut table = Table::new();
    table.load_preset(UTF8_FULL).apply_modifier(UTF8_ROUND_CORNERS).set_header(Row::from(vec![
        "Turn",
        "Role",
        "Tool Invocations",
        "Tokens (In / Write / Read / Out)",
    ]));

    for turn in &transcript.turns {
        let tool_summary = if turn.tool_calls.is_empty() {
            "-".to_string()
        } else {
            turn.tool_calls.iter().map(|c| format!("{}({})", c.tool_name, c.call_id)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ")
        };

        let token_summary = if let Some(u) = turn.usage {
            format!("{}/{}/{}/{}", u.input_tokens, u.cache_creation_tokens, u.cache_read_tokens, u.output_tokens)
        } else {
            "-".to_string()
        };

        table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
            Cell::new(turn.turn_index.to_string()),
            Cell::new(format!("{:?}", turn.role)),
            Cell::new(tool_summary),
            Cell::new(token_summary),
        ]));
    }

    println!("{table}");
    Ok(())
}

fn cmd_audit(path: &Path, json_mode: bool) -> Result<()> {
    let transcript = load_session(path)?;
    let eco = &transcript.economics;

    if json_mode {
        let json_out = serde_json::to_string_pretty(eco).into_diagnostic()?;
        println!("{}", json_out);
        return Ok(());
    }

    println!("\n Token Economics & Cache Audit: {}", transcript.session_id);
    println!(" Model: {}\n", transcript.model_family);

    let mut table = Table::new();
    table.load_preset(UTF8_FULL).apply_modifier(UTF8_ROUND_CORNERS).set_header(Row::from(vec!["Metric", "Value"]));

    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Uncached Input Tokens", &format!("{}", eco.input_tokens)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Cache Creation (5m Write)", &format!("{}", eco.cache_creation_tokens)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Cache Read (0.10x Discount)", &format!("{}", eco.cache_read_tokens)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Output Tokens", &format!("{}", eco.output_tokens)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
        Cell::new("Cache Hit Ratio").fg(Color::Green),
        Cell::new(format!("{:.1}%", eco.cache_hit_ratio)).fg(Color::Green),
    ]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
        Cell::new("Actual USD Spend").fg(Color::Cyan),
        Cell::new(format!("${:.4}", eco.total_cost_usd)).fg(Color::Cyan),
    ]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Baseline Cost (No Cache)", &format!("${:.4}", eco.baseline_cost_no_cache_usd)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
        Cell::new("Net Savings USD").fg(Color::Green),
        Cell::new(format!("${:.4}", eco.net_savings_usd)).fg(Color::Green),
    ]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
        Cell::new("Efficiency Multiplier").fg(Color::Yellow),
        Cell::new(format!("{:.2}x", eco.efficiency_multiplier)).fg(Color::Yellow),
    ]));

    println!("{table}");
    Ok(())
}

fn cmd_scan(dir: &Path, json_mode: bool) -> Result<()> {
    use std::fs;

    let mut sessions = Vec::new();

    if dir.is_dir() {
        for entry in fs::read_dir(dir).into_diagnostic()? {
            let entry = entry.into_diagnostic()?;
            let path = entry.path();
            if path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some("jsonl") {
                if let Ok(transcript) = load_session(&path) {
                    sessions.push(transcript);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if json_mode {
        let json_out = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&sessions).into_diagnostic()?;
        println!("{}", json_out);
        return Ok(());
    }

    println!("\n Multi-Session Directory Scan: {}", dir.display());
    println!(" Total Sessions Discovered: {}\n", sessions.len());

    let mut table = Table::new();
    table.load_preset(UTF8_FULL).apply_modifier(UTF8_ROUND_CORNERS).set_header(Row::from(vec![
        "Session ID",
        "Orchestrator",
        "Turns",
        "Cache Hit %",
        "Cost USD",
        "Savings USD",
    ]));

    for sess in &sessions {
        table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
            Cell::new(sess.session_id.as_str()),
            Cell::new(format!("{:?}", sess.orchestrator)),
            Cell::new(sess.turns.len().to_string()),
            Cell::new(format!("{:.1}%", sess.economics.cache_hit_ratio)),
            Cell::new(format!("${:.4}", sess.economics.total_cost_usd)),
            Cell::new(format!("${:.4}", sess.economics.net_savings_usd)),
        ]));
    }

    println!("{table}");
    Ok(())
}

[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = [
    "crates/lumen-model",
    "crates/lumen-session",
    "crates/lumen-analysis",
    "crates/lumen-pattern",
    "crates/lumen-store",
    "crates/lumen-fixtures",
    "crates/lumen-cli",
]

[workspace.package]
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.96"
authors = ["Gabriel Castro (Orin DX)"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/orin-dx/lumen"

[workspace.dependencies]
# Internal workspace crates
lumen-model = { path = "crates/lumen-model" }
lumen-session = { path = "crates/lumen-session" }
lumen-analysis = { path = "crates/lumen-analysis" }
lumen-pattern = { path = "crates/lumen-pattern" }
lumen-store = { path = "crates/lumen-store" }
lumen-fixtures = { path = "crates/lumen-fixtures" }

# Database & Storage
rusqlite = { version = "0.32", features = ["bundled", "chrono"] }
r2d2 = "0.8"
r2d2_sqlite = "0.25"
camino = { version = "1.1", features = ["serde1"] }
tempfile = "3.13"
proptest = "1.6"
insta = { version = "1.41", features = ["json", "yaml", "redactions"] }
rstest = "0.23"
pretty_assertions = "1.4"
criterion = "0.5"




# Data structures & serialization
compact_str = { version = "0.8", features = ["serde"] }
smallvec = { version = "1.13", features = ["serde"] }
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }

cast_sign_loss = "allow"



use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
use comfy_table::modifiers::UTF8_ROUND_CORNERS;
use comfy_table::presets::UTF8_FULL;
use comfy_table::{Cell, Color, Row, Table};
use lumen_model::*;
use lumen_session::*;
use miette::{IntoDiagnostic, Result};
use std::fs::File;
use std::io::BufReader;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
#[command(name = "lumen", author, version, about = "Multi-orchestrator telemetry & session intelligence engine")]
pub struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    pub command: Commands,

    #[arg(long, global = true, help = "Emit machine-readable JSON format")]
    pub json: bool,
}

#[derive(Subcommand, Debug)]
pub enum Commands {
    /// Render execution trajectory DAG and timeline
    Trace {
        /// Path to JSONL session log
        session_path: PathBuf,
    },
    /// Audit token economics, prompt cache hit %, and USD cost
    Audit {
        /// Path to JSONL session log
        session_path: PathBuf,
    },
    /// Parallel scan across all sessions in a directory
    Scan {
        /// Directory to scan
        #[arg(default_value = ".")]
        dir: PathBuf,
    },
}

fn main() -> Result<()> {
    let cli = Cli::parse();

    match cli.command {
        Commands::Trace { session_path } => cmd_trace(&session_path, cli.json)?,
        Commands::Audit { session_path } => cmd_audit(&session_path, cli.json)?,
        Commands::Scan { dir } => cmd_scan(&dir, cli.json)?,
    }

    Ok(())
}

fn load_session(path: &Path) -> Result<CanonicalTranscript> {
    let file = File::open(path).into_diagnostic()?;
    let reader = BufReader::new(file);

    // Read initial sample for fingerprinting
    let mut sample_file = File::open(path).into_diagnostic()?;
    let mut buffer = [0u8; 2048];
    use std::io::Read;
    let n = sample_file.read(&mut buffer).unwrap_or(0);
    let sample = &buffer[..n];

    let orchestrator = detect_orchestrator(sample).unwrap_or(OrchestratorKind::ClaudeCode);

    match orchestrator {
        OrchestratorKind::ClaudeCode => ClaudeCodeAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
        OrchestratorKind::Antigravity => AgyAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
        OrchestratorKind::Codex => CodexAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
        OrchestratorKind::OpenCode => OpenCodeAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
        _ => ClaudeCodeAdapter.parse_stream(Box::new(reader)).into_diagnostic(),
    }
}

fn cmd_trace(path: &Path, json_mode: bool) -> Result<()> {
    let transcript = load_session(path)?;

    if json_mode {
        let json_out = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&transcript).into_diagnostic()?;
        println!("{}", json_out);
        return Ok(());
    }

    println!("\n Session Trajectory: {}", transcript.session_id);
    println!(" Orchestrator: {:?} | Model: {}", transcript.orchestrator, transcript.model_family);
    println!(" Turns: {} | Wall Time: {}ms\n", transcript.turns.len(), transcript.timing.wall_duration_ms);

    let mut table = Table::new();
    table.load_preset(UTF8_FULL).apply_modifier(UTF8_ROUND_CORNERS).set_header(Row::from(vec![
        "Turn",
        "Role",
        "Tool Invocations",
        "Tokens (In / Write / Read / Out)",
    ]));

    for turn in &transcript.turns {
        let tool_summary = if turn.tool_calls.is_empty() {
            "-".to_string()
        } else {
            turn.tool_calls.iter().map(|c| format!("{}({})", c.tool_name, c.call_id)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ")
        };

        let token_summary = if let Some(u) = turn.usage {
            format!("{}/{}/{}/{}", u.input_tokens, u.cache_creation_tokens, u.cache_read_tokens, u.output_tokens)
        } else {
            "-".to_string()
        };

        table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
            Cell::new(turn.turn_index.to_string()),
            Cell::new(format!("{:?}", turn.role)),
            Cell::new(tool_summary),
            Cell::new(token_summary),
        ]));
    }

    println!("{table}");
    Ok(())
}

fn cmd_audit(path: &Path, json_mode: bool) -> Result<()> {
    let transcript = load_session(path)?;
    let eco = &transcript.economics;

    if json_mode {
        let json_out = serde_json::to_string_pretty(eco).into_diagnostic()?;
        println!("{}", json_out);
        return Ok(());
    }

    println!("\n Token Economics & Cache Audit: {}", transcript.session_id);
    println!(" Model: {}\n", transcript.model_family);

    let mut table = Table::new();
    table.load_preset(UTF8_FULL).apply_modifier(UTF8_ROUND_CORNERS).set_header(Row::from(vec!["Metric", "Value"]));

    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Uncached Input Tokens", &format!("{}", eco.input_tokens)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Cache Creation (5m Write)", &format!("{}", eco.cache_creation_tokens)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Cache Read (0.10x Discount)", &format!("{}", eco.cache_read_tokens)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Output Tokens", &format!("{}", eco.output_tokens)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
        Cell::new("Cache Hit Ratio").fg(Color::Green),
        Cell::new(format!("{:.1}%", eco.cache_hit_ratio)).fg(Color::Green),
    ]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
        Cell::new("Actual USD Spend").fg(Color::Cyan),
        Cell::new(format!("${:.4}", eco.total_cost_usd)).fg(Color::Cyan),
    ]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec!["Baseline Cost (No Cache)", &format!("${:.4}", eco.baseline_cost_no_cache_usd)]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
        Cell::new("Net Savings USD").fg(Color::Green),
        Cell::new(format!("${:.4}", eco.net_savings_usd)).fg(Color::Green),
    ]));
    table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
        Cell::new("Efficiency Multiplier").fg(Color::Yellow),
        Cell::new(format!("{:.2}x", eco.efficiency_multiplier)).fg(Color::Yellow),
    ]));

    println!("{table}");
    Ok(())
}

fn cmd_scan(dir: &Path, json_mode: bool) -> Result<()> {
    use std::fs;

    let mut sessions = Vec::new();

    if dir.is_dir() {
        for entry in fs::read_dir(dir).into_diagnostic()? {
            let entry = entry.into_diagnostic()?;
            let path = entry.path();
            if path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some("jsonl") {
                if let Ok(transcript) = load_session(&path) {
                    sessions.push(transcript);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if json_mode {
        let json_out = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&sessions).into_diagnostic()?;
        println!("{}", json_out);
        return Ok(());
    }

    println!("\n Multi-Session Directory Scan: {}", dir.display());
    println!(" Total Sessions Discovered: {}\n", sessions.len());

    let mut table = Table::new();
    table.load_preset(UTF8_FULL).apply_modifier(UTF8_ROUND_CORNERS).set_header(Row::from(vec![
        "Session ID",
        "Orchestrator",
        "Turns",
        "Cache Hit %",
        "Cost USD",
        "Savings USD",
    ]));

    for sess in &sessions {
        table.add_row(Row::from(vec![
            Cell::new(sess.session_id.as_str()),
            Cell::new(format!("{:?}", sess.orchestrator)),
            Cell::new(sess.turns.len().to_string()),
            Cell::new(format!("{:.1}%", sess.economics.cache_hit_ratio)),
            Cell::new(format!("${:.4}", sess.economics.total_cost_usd)),
            Cell::new(format!("${:.4}", sess.economics.net_savings_usd)),
        ]));
    }

    println!("{table}");
    Ok(())
}

README.md:329:> Streaming-ingestion throughput (large JSONL files) and multi-session directory-scan benchmarks are not yet measured — they need a checked-in 50MB+ fixture and a multi-session corpus that don't exist in this repo yet. Previous figures for these (`31.4 ms`/50MB, `118 ms`/200 sessions) were unmeasured and have been removed rather than left unverified; they'll be restored once real fixtures and benches exist.
specs/PLAN-LUMEN-005-ANALYSIS.json:255:        "implementation": "Create HookActivityAccumulator in crates/lumen-analysis/src/accumulators/hook_activity.rs implementing RawMessageAccumulator. Struct fields per spec api_surface: hook_invocations: usize, by_event: BTreeMap<CompactString, usize>, total_duration_ms: u64, blocked_count: usize -- plus two derived output-only fields block_rate: f64 and avg_duration_ms: f64 (added because the trait's `Output = Self` leaves no separate metrics type to carry the computed rates). In update_raw(): if message[\"hookEventName\"] is a string, increment hook_invocations, increment by_event[event_name], add message[\"durationMs\"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) to total_duration_ms; independently (not gated on hookEventName presence), if message[\"decision\"] == \"block\" or message[\"permissionDecision\"] == \"deny\", increment blocked_count. In finalize(mut self) -> Self: set self.block_rate = blocked_count as f64 / hook_invocations as f64 and self.avg_duration_ms = total_duration_ms as f64 / hook_invocations as f64 when hook_invocations > 0, else 0.0 for both; return self. Export from mod.rs. Do NOT wire into engine.rs::process_transcript -- that function only receives an already-parsed &CanonicalTranscript with no raw JSON available, mirroring how the existing TokenUsageAccumulator (also RawMessageAccumulator) is intentionally left unwired and tested standalone in test_accumulators.rs.",

specs/SPEC-LUMEN-002-SESSION.json:167:      "criterion": "THE SYSTEM SHALL provide a synthetic_50mb_session(orchestrator: OrchestratorKind, seed: u64) fixture generator in crates/lumen-fixtures that deterministically expands a real corpus template to at least 50MB without any binary fixture file being checked into the repository, and a criterion benchmark in crates/lumen-session/benches/ SHALL assert that parse_stream over that generated fixture completes in under 35 milliseconds, providing the concrete measurement path CRIT-LUMEN-029 currently lacks. NOTE: this benchmarks parse_stream's actual current reader path (a buffered line reader); it does not itself require memory-mapped I/O, since memmap2 is a declared lumen-session dependency (Cargo.toml) that is not yet used by any parsing code path -- CRIT-LUMEN-029's \"memory-mapped\" framing is aspirational relative to the current implementation, a pre-existing gap outside this amendment's scope to resolve.",

specs/PLAN-LUMEN-005-ANALYSIS.json:255:        "implementation": "Create HookActivityAccumulator in crates/lumen-analysis/src/accumulators/hook_activity.rs implementing RawMessageAccumulator. Struct fields per spec api_surface: hook_invocations: usize, by_event: BTreeMap<CompactString, usize>, total_duration_ms: u64, blocked_count: usize -- plus two derived output-only fields block_rate: f64 and avg_duration_ms: f64 (added because the trait's `Output = Self` leaves no separate metrics type to carry the computed rates). In update_raw(): if message[\"hookEventName\"] is a string, increment hook_invocations, increment by_event[event_name], add message[\"durationMs\"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) to total_duration_ms; independently (not gated on hookEventName presence), if message[\"decision\"] == \"block\" or message[\"permissionDecision\"] == \"deny\", increment blocked_count. In finalize(mut self) -> Self: set self.block_rate = blocked_count as f64 / hook_invocations as f64 and self.avg_duration_ms = total_duration_ms as f64 / hook_invocations as f64 when hook_invocations > 0, else 0.0 for both; return self. Export from mod.rs. Do NOT wire into engine.rs::process_transcript -- that function only receives an already-parsed &CanonicalTranscript with no raw JSON available, mirroring how the existing TokenUsageAccumulator (also RawMessageAccumulator) is intentionally left unwired and tested standalone in test_accumulators.rs.",

};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AnalysisReport {
    pub session_id: String,
    pub circuit_breaker: CircuitBreakerReport,
    pub turn_durations: TurnDurationMetrics,

    pub mcp_affinity: McpAffinityMetrics,
    pub self_corrections: SelfCorrectionMetrics,
    pub context_growth: ContextGrowthMetrics,
    pub tool_inventory: ToolInventoryMetrics,
    pub autonomy: AutonomyMetrics,
    pub permission_mode: PermissionMetrics,
    pub artifacts: ArtifactMetrics,
    pub pr_link: PrLinkMetrics,
    pub flow: FlowMetrics,
    pub fuzzy_tools: FuzzyToolsMetrics,
    pub stats: StatsMetrics,
    pub schema_extractor: Vec<SchemaCitation>,
    pub attribution: AttributionMetrics,
    pub by_subagent: BTreeMap<CompactString, AttributionMetrics>,
    pub trajectory_dag: Vec<ToolNode>,
    pub timeline: TimelineAccumulator,
    pub otel_correlation: OtelCorrelationReport,
    pub span_mapping: SpanMappingAccumulator,
}

pub struct AnalyticsEngine {
    circuit_breaker: CircuitBreakerAccumulator,
    turn_duration: TurnDurationAccumulator,
    api_health: ApiHealthAccumulator,
    mcp_affinity: McpAffinityAccumulator,
    self_correction: SelfCorrectionAccumulator,
    context_growth: ContextGrowthAccumulator,
    tool_inventory: ToolInventoryAccumulator,
    autonomy: AutonomyAccumulator,
    permission_mode: PermissionModeAccumulator,
    artifacts: ArtifactsAccumulator,
    pr_link: PrLinkAccumulator,
    flow: FlowAccumulator,
    fuzzy_tools: FuzzyToolsAccumulator,
    stats: StatsAccumulator,
    schema_extractor: SchemaExtractorAccumulator,
    attribution: AttributionAccumulator,
    trajectory_dag: TrajectoryDagAccumulator,
    timeline: TimelineAccumulator,
    span_mapping: SpanMappingAccumulator,
}

impl Default for AnalyticsEngine {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl AnalyticsEngine {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            circuit_breaker: CircuitBreakerAccumulator::default(),
            turn_duration: TurnDurationAccumulator::default(),
            api_health: ApiHealthAccumulator::default(),
            mcp_affinity: McpAffinityAccumulator::default(),
            self_correction: SelfCorrectionAccumulator::default(),
            context_growth: ContextGrowthAccumulator::default(),
            tool_inventory: ToolInventoryAccumulator::default(),
            autonomy: AutonomyAccumulator::default(),
            permission_mode: PermissionModeAccumulator::default(),
            artifacts: ArtifactsAccumulator::default(),
            pr_link: PrLinkAccumulator::default(),
            flow: FlowAccumulator::default(),
            fuzzy_tools: FuzzyToolsAccumulator::default(),
            stats: StatsAccumulator::default(),
            schema_extractor: SchemaExtractorAccumulator::default(),
            attribution: AttributionAccumulator::default(),
            trajectory_dag: TrajectoryDagAccumulator::default(),
            timeline: TimelineAccumulator::default(),
            span_mapping: SpanMappingAccumulator::default(),
        }
    }

    /// Single-pass execution of all accumulators over the canonical transcript.
    pub fn process_transcript(mut self, transcript: &CanonicalTranscript) -> AnalysisReport {
        for turn in &transcript.turns {
            self.circuit_breaker.update(turn);
            self.turn_duration.update(turn);
            self.api_health.update(turn);
            self.mcp_affinity.update(turn);
            self.self_correction.update(turn);
            self.context_growth.update(turn);
            self.tool_inventory.update(turn);
            self.autonomy.update(turn);
            self.permission_mode.update(turn);
            self.artifacts.update(turn);
            self.pr_link.update(turn);
            self.flow.update(turn);
            self.fuzzy_tools.update(turn);
            self.stats.update(turn);
            self.schema_extractor.update(turn);
            self.attribution.update(turn);
            self.trajectory_dag.update(turn);
            self.timeline.update(turn);
            self.span_mapping.update(turn);
        }

        let mut by_subagent = BTreeMap::new();
        for subagent in &transcript.subagents {
            let sub_report = AnalyticsEngine::new().process_transcript(subagent);
            by_subagent.insert(CompactString::from(subagent.session_id.as_str()), sub_report.attribution);
        }

        AnalysisReport {
            session_id: transcript.session_id.to_string(),
            circuit_breaker: self.circuit_breaker.finalize(),
            turn_durations: self.turn_duration.finalize(),
            api_health: self.api_health.finalize(),
            mcp_affinity: self.mcp_affinity.finalize(),
            self_corrections: self.self_correction.finalize(),
            context_growth: self.context_growth.finalize(),
            tool_inventory: self.tool_inventory.finalize(),
            autonomy: self.autonomy.finalize(),
            permission_mode: self.permission_mode.finalize(),
            artifacts: self.artifacts.finalize(),
            pr_link: self.pr_link.finalize(),
            flow: self.flow.finalize(),
            fuzzy_tools: self.fuzzy_tools.finalize(),
            stats: self.stats.finalize(),
            schema_extractor: self.schema_extractor.finalize(),
            attribution: self.attribution.finalize(),
            by_subagent,
            trajectory_dag: self.trajectory_dag.finalize(),
            timeline: self.timeline.finalize(),
            otel_correlation: OtelCorrelationAccumulator::finalize(transcript),
            span_mapping: self.span_mapping.finalize(),
        }
    }
}

    TurnDurationAccumulator, TurnDurationMetrics,
};
use crate::traits::EntryAccumulator;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AnalysisReport {
    pub session_id: String,
    pub circuit_breaker: CircuitBreakerReport,
    pub turn_durations: TurnDurationMetrics,
    pub api_health: ApiHealthMetrics,
    pub mcp_affinity: McpAffinityMetrics,
    pub self_corrections: SelfCorrectionMetrics,
    pub context_growth: ContextGrowthMetrics,
    pub tool_inventory: ToolInventoryMetrics,
    pub autonomy: AutonomyMetrics,
    pub permission_mode: PermissionMetrics,
    pub artifacts: ArtifactMetrics,
    pub pr_link: PrLinkMetrics,
    pub flow: FlowMetrics,
    pub fuzzy_tools: FuzzyToolsMetrics,
    pub stats: StatsMetrics,
    pub schema_extractor: Vec<SchemaCitation>,
    pub attribution: AttributionMetrics,
    pub by_subagent: BTreeMap<CompactString, AttributionMetrics>,
    pub trajectory_dag: Vec<ToolNode>,
    pub timeline: TimelineAccumulator,
    pub otel_correlation: OtelCorrelationReport,
    pub span_mapping: SpanMappingAccumulator,
}

pub struct AnalyticsEngine {
    circuit_breaker: CircuitBreakerAccumulator,
    turn_duration: TurnDurationAccumulator,
    api_health: ApiHealthAccumulator,
    mcp_affinity: McpAffinityAccumulator,
    self_correction: SelfCorrectionAccumulator,
    context_growth: ContextGrowthAccumulator,
    tool_inventory: ToolInventoryAccumulator,
    autonomy: AutonomyAccumulator,
    permission_mode: PermissionModeAccumulator,
    artifacts: ArtifactsAccumulator,
    pr_link: PrLinkAccumulator,
    flow: FlowAccumulator,
    fuzzy_tools: FuzzyToolsAccumulator,
    stats: StatsAccumulator,
    schema_extractor: SchemaExtractorAccumulator,
    attribution: AttributionAccumulator,
    trajectory_dag: TrajectoryDagAccumulator,
    timeline: TimelineAccumulator,
    span_mapping: SpanMappingAccumulator,
}

impl Default for AnalyticsEngine {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl AnalyticsEngine {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            circuit_breaker: CircuitBreakerAccumulator::default(),
            turn_duration: TurnDurationAccumulator::default(),
            api_health: ApiHealthAccumulator::default(),
            mcp_affinity: McpAffinityAccumulator::default(),
            self_correction: SelfCorrectionAccumulator::default(),
            context_growth: ContextGrowthAccumulator::default(),
            tool_inventory: ToolInventoryAccumulator::default(),
            autonomy: AutonomyAccumulator::default(),
            permission_mode: PermissionModeAccumulator::default(),
            artifacts: ArtifactsAccumulator::default(),
            pr_link: PrLinkAccumulator::default(),
            flow: FlowAccumulator::default(),
            fuzzy_tools: FuzzyToolsAccumulator::default(),
            stats: StatsAccumulator::default(),
            schema_extractor: SchemaExtractorAccumulator::default(),
            attribution: AttributionAccumulator::default(),
            trajectory_dag: TrajectoryDagAccumulator::default(),
            timeline: TimelineAccumulator::default(),
            span_mapping: SpanMappingAccumulator::default(),
        }
    }

    /// Single-pass execution of all accumulators over the canonical transcript.
    pub fn process_transcript(mut self, transcript: &CanonicalTranscript) -> AnalysisReport {
        for turn in &transcript.turns {
            self.circuit_breaker.update(turn);
            self.turn_duration.update(turn);
            self.api_health.update(turn);
            self.mcp_affinity.update(turn);
            self.self_correction.update(turn);
            self.context_growth.update(turn);
            self.tool_inventory.update(turn);
            self.autonomy.update(turn);
            self.permission_mode.update(turn);
            self.artifacts.update(turn);
            self.pr_link.update(turn);
            self.flow.update(turn);
            self.fuzzy_tools.update(turn);
            self.stats.update(turn);
            self.schema_extractor.update(turn);
            self.attribution.update(turn);
            self.trajectory_dag.update(turn);
            self.timeline.update(turn);
            self.span_mapping.update(turn);
        }

        let mut by_subagent = BTreeMap::new();
        for subagent in &transcript.subagents {
            let sub_report = AnalyticsEngine::new().process_transcript(subagent);
            by_subagent.insert(CompactString::from(subagent.session_id.as_str()), sub_report.attribution);
        }

        AnalysisReport {
            session_id: transcript.session_id.to_string(),
            circuit_breaker: self.circuit_breaker.finalize(),
            turn_durations: self.turn_duration.finalize(),
            api_health: self.api_health.finalize(),
            mcp_affinity: self.mcp_affinity.finalize(),
            self_corrections: self.self_correction.finalize(),
            context_growth: self.context_growth.finalize(),
            tool_inventory: self.tool_inventory.finalize(),
            autonomy: self.autonomy.finalize(),
            permission_mode: self.permission_mode.finalize(),
            artifacts: self.artifacts.finalize(),
            pr_link: self.pr_link.finalize(),
            flow: self.flow.finalize(),
            fuzzy_tools: self.fuzzy_tools.finalize(),
            stats: self.stats.finalize(),
            schema_extractor: self.schema_extractor.finalize(),
            attribution: self.attribution.finalize(),
            by_subagent,
            trajectory_dag: self.trajectory_dag.finalize(),
            timeline: self.timeline.finalize(),
            otel_correlation: OtelCorrelationAccumulator::finalize(transcript),
            span_mapping: self.span_mapping.finalize(),
        }
    }
}

content.text:
Lumen is a local-first observability and intelligence engine for AI coding-agent sessions. It ingests raw Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, and OpenCode logs; normalizes them into one transcript IR; calculates prompt-cache economics; analyzes behavior and tool trajectories; and surfaces waste, loops, latency, and workflow findings.

The implemented core is:

```text
agent JSONL logs
  → lumen-session: detect + parse + normalize
  → lumen-model: canonical transcript + token pricing
  → lumen-analysis: single-pass behavioral metrics
  → lumen-pattern: Tarjan SCC loop detection
  → lumen-cli: trace / audit / scan
```

The repo’s main docs are:

- [README.md](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/README.md) — product overview, examples, user-facing commands, accumulator catalog, benchmarks.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/ARCHITECTURE.md) — crate boundaries, licensing, pipeline, cache-cost formulas, loop invariant.
- [docs/01-canonical-model-and-economics.md](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/docs/01-canonical-model-and-economics.md) — canonical IR, memory-conscious types, pricing math.
- [docs/02-streaming-ingestion-and-adapters.md](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/docs/02-streaming-ingestion-and-adapters.md) — adapters and pre-compaction `max()` merge rule.
- [docs/03-22-accumulators-and-analytics.md](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/docs/03-22-accumulators-and-analytics.md) — the telemetry accumulator contracts and inventory.
- [docs/04-trajectory-dag-and-loop-detection.md](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/docs/04-trajectory-dag-and-loop-detection.md) — tool-transition graph, Tarjan loop criteria, six trajectory measures.
- [docs/05-lumen-cli-and-tui.md](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/docs/05-lumen-cli-and-tui.md) — intended CLI surface and deterministic JSON output.
- [docs/06-sqlite-store-and-daemon-architecture.md](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/docs/06-sqlite-store-and-daemon-architecture.md) — SQLite WAL, single-writer daemon design, queueing, migrations, privacy-oriented facts storage.
- [docs/07-data-presentation-and-ui-design-standard.md](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/docs/07-data-presentation-and-ui-design-standard.md), [08](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/docs/08-lumen-mac-swift-native-app-blueprint.md), [09](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/docs/09-enterprise-adoption-and-commercial-strategy.md), and [10](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/docs/10-the-six-generational-leaps.md) — explicitly marked vision/roadmap: dense data presentation, native Mac app, enterprise/privacy/OTel strategy, and future “flight controller” features.

The machine-readable acceptance specs are the clearest contract for each subsystem:

| Spec | Contract |
|---|---|
| [001 Model](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/specs/SPEC-LUMEN-001-MODEL.json) | IR and multi-provider token/caching economics |
| [002 Session](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/specs/SPEC-LUMEN-002-SESSION.json) | adapters, fingerprinting, resilience, snapshots |
| [003 Store](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/specs/SPEC-LUMEN-003-STORE.json) | SQLite/WAL repositories and read contracts |
| [004 Daemon](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/specs/SPEC-LUMEN-004-DAEMON.json) | single writer, hooks, worker, LaunchAgent |
| [005 Analysis](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/specs/SPEC-LUMEN-005-ANALYSIS.json) | 22 O(N) accumulators |
| [006 Pattern](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/specs/SPEC-LUMEN-006-PATTERN.json) | graph scoring and SCC loop detection |
| [007 Insights](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/specs/SPEC-LUMEN-007-INSIGHTS.json) | workflow categories and RTK missed-savings rules |
| [008 CLI](/Users/gabe/Projects/lumen/specs/SPEC-LUMEN-008-CLI.json) | TUI, doctor, human/JSON/TOON formats |

There are also implementation/test plans for model, session, and analysis under `specs/PLAN-*.json`.

A few important reality checks I’ll carry forward:

- `lumen-model`, `lumen-session`, `lumen-analysis`, `lumen-pattern`, `lumen-store`, fixtures, and CLI exist in the workspace. The daemon, insights crate, Mac app, cloud service, and live flight-controller behavior do not.
- The current CLI implements `trace`, `audit`, and `scan`; commands such as `insights`, `doctor`, and TOON output remain specified future surface.
- The analysis engine wires 19 turn-level accumulators. Raw-message-only token usage and hook activity have separate contracts and are not wired through the canonical-transcript engine.
- Some roadmap prose says `lumen-store` does not exist, but it now does; the workspace and store spec are more current than that statement.
- Core invariants are strict: no unsafe Rust, linear streaming analysis, no cache double-counting, zero-safe economics, and loop anomalies only for SCCs of depth at least three with identical targets and no mutations.

So my working model is: Lumen starts as an accurate, offline session forensics CLI, then grows into a privacy-preserving local database and daemon that can proactively steer agents away from costly, circular work.

Current status: functionally healthy, but not CI-clean.

- `just test` passes across all workspace crates, including model, session adapters, analysis, graph, store, fixtures, and CLI.
- `just ci` currently fails at formatting only: `crates/lumen-analysis/tests/test_accumulators.rs` has rustfmt diffs. Lint was not reached.
- The worktree is intentionally/actively dirty: substantial uncommitted additions and edits span adapters, accumulators, fixtures, store, specs, docs, and task-runner configuration. I made no changes.

Implementation maturity:

- Core offline pipeline is present: model → multi-orchestrator parsing → analysis → graph detection → CLI.
- SQLite/WAL storage is implemented and tested, despite older roadmap wording that says it is absent.
- Current CLI is still limited to `trace`, `audit`, and `scan`.
- Daemon, live hooks, insights/category engine, TOON output, Mac app, cloud/OTel export, replay/distillation, and proactive loop intervention remain planned rather than implemented.

The immediate release blocker is simply formatting the accumulator test file, then rerunning `just ci`.
